findings.title: The new passkey predicate is invoked with the wrong signature
findings.body: `UsernameForm` calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments, but the predicate added on `UsernamePasswordForm` is `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)`. No no-argument overload is declared in this class hierarchy, so this does not compile. Pass `context.getUser()` to the predicate (or provide a matching overload) before merging.

findings.title: Conditional passkeys are no longer initialized for an initial login
findings.body: The new predicate returns false whenever `context.getUser()` is null. This predicate now guards `fillContextForm` in both `authenticate` and the error challenge path, whereas the previous code explicitly initialized conditional WebAuthn when no user had been selected. Initial browser logins necessarily have no context user, including discoverable-passkey login, so the form no longer receives the conditional-UI flag, RP/challenge data, or WebAuthn form and users cannot start a normal passkey login. The predicate/call sites must still initialize conditional passkeys when the feature and realm policy are enabled with no selected user.
